question: Reason for your recommendation
description: 2 sentences max. Note key points only.

question: Website
description: Official website link

question: Operational Footprint
description: Countries/regions where the provider sells or installs equipment.

question: Founded Year
description: Year founded

question: Current Industry / Main Market
description: Main industry served. e.g. fashion logistics, textiles, apparel manufacturing, industrial packaging, e-commerce fulfillment.

question: Off-the-Shelf Solution?
description: Yes/No. Confirm whether the machine is commercially available as a standard product. No is out of scope.

question: Current scale
description: Should be industrial scale.

question: Industrial Scale Evidence
description: Reference throughput data, named customers, installed base, or industry certifications.

question: Current use in Fashion/Textiles?
description: Indicate whether the provider states the machine can be used for garments, textiles, fashion, leather goods, or soft goods, or have a client in the fashion/textile industry.

question: Fashion/Textile Use Case Evidence
description: Describe evidence: explicit fashion/textile page, case study, customer example, brochure image, video, or general claim.

question: Adaptability to fashion applications
description: If the machine is not currently used in fashion/textiles, briefly explain its potential applicability and the key modifications required. e.g. Can be adapted for fashion applications because the vacuum-sealing process is claimed to be material-agnostic.

question: Target Fashion/Textile Products
description: Examples: garments, ready-to-wear, coats, jackets, knitwear, uniforms, bedding, curtains, leather goods, shoes, accessories.

question: Technology Overview
description: Brief description of the technology. 2-3 sentences.

question: Machine / System Type
description: Chamber vacuum, external vacuum, vertical vacuum packer, compression vacuum packer, shrink/vacuum system, bagging line, automated packaging line, etc.

question: Vacuum Technology / Mechanism
description: Briefly explain how vacuum/compression/sealing works.

question: Automation Level
description: Manual / Semi-automatic / Automatic / Fully integrated line.

question: Machine Dimensions
description: Overall machine dimensions with units.

question: Chamber / Sealing Area Dimensions
description: Chamber size, sealing bar length, usable packing area, or bag size range.

question: Packaging Capacity / Throughput
description: Cycles/hour, packs/hour, units/day, or other numeric capacity.

question: Number of Products per Vacuum Cycle
description: How many garments/products can be vacuumed per cycle.

question: Compatible Product Sizes / Materials
description: Product size limits, thickness, weight, fabric/material restrictions.

question: Accessory Requirements
description: Required accessories: vacuum bags, sealing films, liners, compressors, pumps, conveyors, carts, etc.

question: Bag / Film Compatibility
description: Compatible bags/films: PE, PA/PE, vacuum bags, shrink bags, reusable bags, custom bags, etc.

question: Lead Time / Delivery Time
description: Manufacturing lead time, delivery time, installation time, or quote-based timing.

question: Installation Requirements
description: Power, compressed air, floor space, conveyor integration, ventilation, operator station, etc.

question: Process Flow
description: Use > separator. e.g. Garment folding > Bag loading > Vacuum cycle > Heat sealing > Unloading > Storage/transport.

question: Required Steps Before Vacuum
description: Any folding, sorting, pre-bagging, garment protection, inserting labels, drying, or inspection required before vacuum.

question: Required Steps After Vacuum
description: Any ironing, steaming, reshaping, airing out, quality check, relabeling, repacking, or recovery time required after vacuum.

question: Protection Claims
description: Provider claims related to protection. e.g. protects from dust, insects, moisture.

question: Volume Reduction / Space-Saving Claims
description: Provider claims related to volume or space reduction.

question: Transport / Logistics Claims
description: Claims related to freight, container optimization, storage, warehouse, e-commerce, or returns logistics.

question: Quality / Appearance Claims
description: Claims related to wrinkles, garment shape, textile recovery, surface finish, odor, color, or appearance.

question: Provider-Claimed Limitations / Risks
description: Provider-stated cons or cautions. e.g. wrinkling, creasing, deformation, unsuitable for delicate garments, leather damage risk, rebound after opening.

question: Risk to Sensitive Textiles / Leather?
description: Yes/No/Unclear.

question: Risk to Sensitive Textiles / Leather Details
description: Whether vacuum may damage delicate fabrics, structured garments, down-filled items, leather, embellishments, or luxury goods.

question: Relevant Certifications / Compliance
description: CE, ISO, machinery safety, packaging standards, or other relevant certifications.

question: After-Sales Support
description: Training, spare parts, remote support, local service, maintenance contract, etc.

question: Warranty / Maintenance
description: Warranty period, pump maintenance, sealing bar replacement, spare parts, service intervals.

question: Accessory Price
description: Price of bags/films/accessories if available.

question: Estimated Machine Price
description: Price or estimated range. Specify currency and whether list price, quote-based, or distributor price.

question: Key Differentiation/Value Proposition
description: Standout features that differentiate this technology from competitors.

question: Limitations/Challenges
description: Focus on negative impact on product quality after vacuum, particularly for sensitive materials.

question: Partnerships/Customers
description: Named customers, case studies, testimonials, videos, or industry examples.

description: Yes/No. If yes, list 1-2 most notable patents. e.g. EP0209882A2

question: Additional Notes
description: Any information not covered in previous columns.
